facts.text: Waynesburg's Stover Scholars receive $5,000 annually toward tuition, up to $500 for conferences, and up to $1,000 to defray internship costs.

sources.title: About the Stover Scholars Program - Waynesburg University
sources.quote: Stover Scholars receive $5,000 each year to apply toward tuition, up to an additional $500 toward the cost of academic conferences, and up to $1,000 to defray the costs of an internship.
